limits: Only wrapper opcodes and the two real AL0 leaf bodies execute. Other terminal entries are explicitly intercepted; supplied return values qualify forwarding only.
Synthetic target labels are used for zero/six argument generic wrapper coverage and are not claimed to identify recovered consumers.
Read tracing covers referenced words and callback data, not all native stack accesses. Twelve/sixteen byte objects end at a protected page boundary.
65E9E0 is a generic native tailcall. Its two argument usage is selected by the actual service factory/call site; the wrapper alone does not encode an argument count.
